items.stem: Under the ASC 606 five-step model, revenue is recognized when:

options.text: The entity satisfies a performance obligation by transferring control
options.rationale: Correct: revenue is recognized as control of the good/service transfers.

options.text: Cash is received from the customer
options.rationale: Cash receipt timing does not determine recognition under ASC 606.
Signing alone does not transfer control.
Invoicing is an administrative act, not the recognition trigger.

items.explanation: Correct: revenue is recognized as control of the good/service transfers.

items.stem: In the statement of cash flows (indirect method), depreciation expense is:

options.text: Added back to net income in operating activities
options.rationale: Correct: depreciation is a non-cash expense added back under the indirect method.
Depreciation is not an investing cash flow.
It is not a financing item.
It must be adjusted for as a non-cash item.

items.explanation: Correct: depreciation is a non-cash expense added back under the indirect method.

items.stem: Under ASC 842, which TWO are true for a lessee's finance lease at commencement? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: lessees recognize a right-of-use asset.
Correct: lessees recognize a lease liability.

options.text: Nothing is recorded on the balance sheet
options.rationale: ASC 842 brings most leases onto the balance sheet.

options.text: The asset is expensed immediately in full
options.rationale: The ROU asset is amortized, not fully expensed at once.

items.explanation: Correct: lessees recognize a right-of-use asset.
